correctness.rationale: For each of n=16,...,20, a direct all-mask predicate recognizes exactly the simplices of the total three-cut complex. The packaged C++ source supplies a deterministic face matching and checks all Hasse incidences for DAG acyclicity by an exhaustive topological sort (354544, 908803, 2103534, 4659180, 10086000 covers). It leaves only one 0-cell and respectively 3,1,1,1,3 critical cells in degrees 6,9,10,11,13. Discrete Morse theory gives the asserted integral sphere wedges. An independently coded Alexander-dual mod-two homology computation confirms all five predicted groups.

value.rationale: The five cases exhaust the explicit, natural finite gap in Question 49 for the smallest unfilled fourth cycle power and total-three-cut parameter. In combination with credited n=15 and n>=21 results they complete the integral homotopy type for all nonvoid orders of this canonical one-parameter graph family. The dimension jumps and ranks 3,1,1,1,3 provide genuine homotopical structure rather than a routine isolated homology count.
